description.value: Ogopogo Burgers & Shakes is a casual diner on Osoyoos's main commercial strip, named after the legendary Okanagan lake monster. The menu leans into comfort food — hand-crafted burgers on brioche buns, Guinness beer-battered fish and chips, gyro donair platters, and loaded fries — making it a hearty refueling stop in a town that sits at the hub of some of the South Okanagan's most popular cycling routes. Takeout and delivery are both available via Clover online ordering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Clover online-ordering page confirms this is a real, active restaurant at 8515 Main St, Osoyoos BC with phone (250) 485-4851, matching OSM. OSM tags delivery=yes and takeaway=yes are corroborated by the Clover ordering platform itself. The menu (burgers, fish & chips, salads, wings, gyro) is visible on the subpage but contains no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities; OSM tags likewise carry none of these.
concerns: OSM address includes unit designator '8515B' but the Clover website lists the address as '8515 MAIN ST' without a unit — minor discrepancy, address confirmation set to null.
OSM opening hours (07:00–21:00) differ from the hours shown on the Clover website (11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. PDT); the website value is likely more current.
The listed website is a third-party Clover ordering platform rather than the business's own site, limiting the depth of verifiable information (no mention of washrooms, parking, Wi-Fi, etc.).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant on Osoyoos Main Street with confirmed phone, active online ordering, and a visible menu. Straightforward inclusion for a cycling-friendly food stop in a major South Okanagan cycling hub.
